title: Core Octet #20
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eight women in a single row.

A photograph of EIGHT women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 8 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Spanish Flamenco Glam / USSBBW]: Spanish woman, mid 50s, cool and composed, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, wavy hair, stiletto nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme magenta-and-gold plain stiletto pumps.

[Lebanese Wedding Glam / Polynesian Goddess]: Lebanese woman, mid 50s, sultry, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, sleek straight hair, square nails (matte). An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme gold platform high-heel mules.

[Slavic glam / Brazilian Booty]: Russian woman, mid 30s, bold and confident, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, long straight platinum-blonde hair, a cold, striking expression, curly hair, coffin nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

[folk-portrait / Heavy Muscle]: Ukrainian woman, mid 30s, sultry, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, long light-brown hair in a thick braid over one shoulder, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, curly hair, stiletto nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto studded boots.

[Spanish Flamenco Glam / Hourglass SSBBW]: Spanish woman, mid 40s, sultry, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, sleek straight hair, stiletto nails (glittery). Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. [glamorous party / Polynesian Goddess]: Korean woman, early 30s, cheerful, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, long sleek black waves, a confident, luminous expression, elegant updo hair, almond nails (matte). Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 8, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
